plans.idea: Faithful to the original: a left text column (logo, then headline, then subhead, all sharing one left edge) sitting vertically centered, with the bottle large on the right over the sun circle, which balances the text's weight.

Product-first mirror: the bottle fills the left third at full height, and a tight right column stacks logo, headline and subhead on one shared left edge with generous right breathing room, so nothing runs to the canvas edge.
Headline-led with a brand sign-off: a large headline block opens at the top left, the logo closes the column at the bottom left as a signature, and the bottle anchors the right half at full height.
